basics.name: Thanh Nguyen
basics.summary: M.Res. student in Applied Mathematics at HCMUT (VNU-HCM). I work on the mathematical foundations of generative models: objective design, density estimation, score/flow matching, and optimal transport. Seeking an AI research internship or research scientist role.

work.company: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT), VNU-HCM
work.summary: Density-Estimation-Based Objective Design for Generative Models (advisor: Dr. Le Xuan Dai).
highlights: Investigated theoretical and empirical properties of training objectives for diffusion models, normalizing flows and VAEs.
Developed a density-estimation formulation connecting KL minimization with score-matching and flow-matching objectives.
Designed comparative experiments on convergence, training stability and sample quality.

work.company: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT), VNU-HCM
work.summary: Bayesian Optimization Algorithms for Machine Learning Models (advisor: Dr. Le Xuan Dai).
highlights: Studied Bayesian optimization for hyperparameter and architecture search in deep learning.
Analysed acquisition strategies and training dynamics to identify limitations in high-dimensional settings.
Evaluated candidate algorithmic improvements on benchmark datasets.
Extracted and cleaned ERP operational and sales data.
Built Power BI dashboards for revenue, production and sales monitoring; supported an approximately 5% reduction in excess inventory.
